scope: Windows developer verification and CI delivery controls for Sandwich Download Manager v0.1. No publishing, signing, deployment, or production credentials are included.

checks: Windows Tauri cargo check or debug build

continuousIntegration.concurrencyPolicy: Cancel an older run for the same Git ref.
continuousIntegration.credentialPolicy: The verification job has no deployment, signing, or production credentials. Pull-request execution is read-only.
continuousIntegration.releasePolicy: CI produces verification evidence only. Public release, signing, or production deployment requires separate attributed human approval.

businessRuleBoundary: Transfer, persistence, filename, collision, and lifecycle rules remain in packages/download-engine. The delivery runner and workflow only invoke consumers and do not duplicate application rules.

evidence: Windows debug build from the locked desktop manifest
locked behavioral test execution for packages/download-engine

traceability.limitation: Independent Windows UI accessibility and assistive-technology evidence remains owned by ENG-15 or a dedicated runtime QA workstream.

evidence: one terminating local/CI command contract and inspectable workflow
traceability.limitation: Only ENG-15 may issue the independent engineering disposition.

knownRisks: The workflow runner label and checkout major tag are mutable upstream references; hard pinning requires a separately governed dependency-update policy.
The default CI build is an unsigned debug application build, not an MSI/NSIS packaging or release-signing claim.
Real Windows WebView runtime, keyboard, and screen-reader verification is outside this delivery-automation boundary and remains independently required.
